subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: The country is facing growing problems due to rapid population growth. Although food production has increased through improved farming, it cannot match the (a) ------- of the population. Moreover, housing demand is increasing as families become smaller and need individual homes, which leads to the division of (b) ------- land. Industrial expansion and construction are also reducing the amount of land available for farming. If this continues, one day people may not even find a place to build homes and may have to live on trees or (c) ------- boats. Adding to the crisis, forests are being cut and water bodies are being filled up to create space for (d) -------. Once, rural areas were full of natural beauty with vast green fields and large trees. But now, these beautiful sights are being spoiled by (e) ------- construction and overpopulation. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) growth; (b) arable; (c) floating; (d) settlement; (e) unplanned;
